display.purpose: Hero headline only; lines authored as spans and risen on load.

title.purpose: Service section headings inside the ruled block; News heading and menu tagline at adjusted sizes.

statement.purpose: The services marquee and the same-day line: large, regular weight, sentence case.

body.purpose: Service paragraphs, ink, max 42ch, bold black lead-in.

shadows.name: pill-float

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The system easing for every CSS transition (GSAP equivalent: expo.out).

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Declared in @theme; unused on the home page.

motion.name: lenis
motion.value: lerp 0.09, wheelMultiplier 1, touchMultiplier 1.4, autoRaf false (driven by gsap.ticker)
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll; not created under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: data-reveal
motion.value: opacity 0 -> 1, y 28px -> 0, 1.1s expo.out; load: delay 0.7s stagger 0.12; scroll: start top 92%, once, stagger 0.09
motion.purpose: Fade-rise for blocks (news cards, text columns, footer).

motion.name: data-rise
motion.value: yPercent 115 -> 0 per line in clipped span, 1.3s expo.out, stagger 0.09; load: delay 0.25s; scroll: start top 85%, once

motion.name: data-rules
motion.value: --rule 0 -> 1 (scaleX from left), 1.4s expo.out, start top 88%, once
motion.purpose: Self-drawing hairlines above and below a service heading.

motion.name: data-wipe
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) -> inset(0 0 0% 0) 1.4s; inner img scale 1.18 -> 1 over 1.6s; expo.out; start top 82%, once
motion.purpose: Framed photo reveal (available to any section; the services block uses its own pinned timeline).

motion.name: services-scroller
motion.value: position: sticky in a tall box, 0.85vh per photo + 0.1 end rest, scrub 0.5, no rests between photos; soft landing over 25vh of travel across 50vh of scroll (content offset y = D*p^2 then D*(1-p)^2, D = 25vh); Property gear lags from -16vh to 0 on the way in (power1.out); photos anchored to stage corners by service (br, tl, bl / tr, bl, tl) with transform-origin at that corner; outgoing scale 1 -> 0.3 over 0.9 steps (quadratic inOut with 20% linear mixed in, opacity to 0 in the last fifth) while incoming scale 0.3 -> 1 starts 0.1 later (opaque within its first fifth); text out 0.2 / in 0.3 mid-step, hairlines --rule 0 -> 1 over 0.35, background icon crossfade with scale 0.9 -> 1; switcher click: fade out 220ms, jump scroll and timeline while hidden, stage scale 0.9 -> 1 from the photo's corner over 800ms expo.out; switcher marker slides 700ms expo-out
motion.purpose: Pinned services block on md+ with motion; ServicesAccordion (grid-template-rows 0fr -> 1fr, 600ms) elsewhere.

motion.name: data-parallax
motion.value: yPercent -n -> +n scrubbed across parent (n = 9 banners, 10 hero, 14 background icons)
motion.purpose: Slow drift of tinted photos and background icons.

motion.name: marquee
motion.value: xPercent -50 over 60s linear loop; timeScale = direction * (1 + min(|velocity|/14, 3.5)), eased 0.8s power2.out; paused off-screen
motion.purpose: Scroll-velocity services marquee; static wrapped line under reduced motion.

motion.name: frame-hover
motion.value: img transform scale(1.035) 1.1s ease-out-expo, hover-capable devices only

motion.name: button-label-slide
motion.value: label translateY(-100%) with twin from top:100%, 0.5s ease-out-expo; colours 0.5s

motion.name: navlink-underline
motion.purpose: Nav link hover and current page.

motion.name: header-pill
motion.value: translateY(-120%) -> 0, 0.7s ease-out-expo, after scrollY > 55% of viewport

motion.name: menu-open
motion.value: panels clip-path inset bottom 100% -> 0, 0.9s stagger 0.06; items y 18 -> 0 + fade 0.8s stagger 0.05 delay 0.2; expo.out

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: html.motion absent; animation/transition durations 0.001ms; Lenis and GSAP matchMedia skipped
motion.purpose: Every reveal target renders visible and still.

components.name: Dotted Rule
components.description: Edge-to-edge 2px dotted divider in translucent brand blue (News section, marquee, footer).

narrative.northStar: The Plant Room at Full Bleed
narrative.overview:
The system reproduces the client designer's desktop mockup and extends it down to mobile. Its whole argument is made by alternation: photographs of JJM's own installations run edge to edge under a navy multiply tint with a white uppercase headline sitting right of centre, and between them the page returns to plain white sections where a navy heading, a brand-blue section icon, a paragraph of ink-grey body and one outlined pill button sit left of a framed photo. Nothing on the page is a tile, a card with a shadow, a stat, a testimonial or a sticky call to action. Trust is carried by the photography and by the restraint around it.

Density is low and the rhythm is long. Sections breathe with clamp()-driven padding, hairlines rather than boxes separate things, and the only ornament is the brand's own icon set, repeated oversized at 12% opacity behind each service section. Work Sans does every job: bold caps for display, regular for body, semibold tracked caps for labels and navigation, light for the copyright line.

Motion is the second material. Lenis smooths the scroll; headline lines rise from clipped boxes; photos wipe open from the bottom and settle from a slight zoom; heading hairlines draw in from the left; the services marquee reads scroll velocity and reverses with the visitor. Every one of these has a reduced-motion state in which the page is simply still and complete.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating full-bleed navy photo banners and white editorial sections
One typeface, Work Sans, in five weights; headings in uppercase bold
Hairline and dotted rules in translucent brand blue instead of boxes or shadows
Outlined pill buttons whose label slides up on hover
Oversized brand icons at 12% opacity as section backdrops
Scroll choreography (rise, wipe, parallax, drawn rules, velocity marquee) with full reduced-motion fallbacks

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: Every photograph that carries text is tinted: a navy ground plus a left-to-right navy gradient (35% to 70%) in multiply blend at 85% opacity. Text on photos is white only.

rules.name: The Translucent Blue Line Rule
rules.body: Rules are never a solid colour. Hairlines are brand blue at 45% (or white at 35% on photos); dotted rules are brand blue at 40%. Full-strength blue is reserved for icons, fills and the accent text.

rules.name: The Ink Body Rule
rules.body: Headings are navy, body is ink. The one deliberate exception is the bold lead-in phrase of a service paragraph, which is black.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Work Sans is the only typeface. No display face, no mono, no system fallback showing by design.

rules.name: The Caps Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a heading, a nav item, a label or a button is uppercase. Body copy, the marquee, the same-day statement, email addresses, phone numbers and the Instagram handle are not.

rules.name: The No-Box Rule
rules.body: Content is never placed in a bordered or shadowed card. Separate with a hairline, a dotted rule, a change of ground (white, mist, frost, navy photo) or whitespace.

dos: Do alternate full-bleed navy-tinted photo bands with white editorial sections; the alternation is the page structure.
Do set every heading in Work Sans 700 uppercase at 1.04 line height, navy on white and white on photos.
Do separate content with 1px blue-45% hairlines or 2px dotted blue-40% rules, never with boxes.
Do use the outlined pill button, one per section, with its sliding label and expo-out timing.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion state in which the content is fully visible and still.
Do keep body copy in ink at 42ch or less, with any bold lead-in in black.
Do place a brand icon at full strength beside a heading and its oversized 12% twin behind the section.
donts: Don't add a second typeface, a monospace or a system display face.
Don't put shadows on anything other than the compact header pill, or use bordered cards, stat tiles, testimonial cards or sticky calls to action.
Don't use cobalt or sky outside the icon artwork.
Don't set text on an untinted photograph.
Don't round the corners of photographs, chips, tags or panels; only pills, roundels and the header pill's bottom edge are round.
Don't canonise the amber placeholder tag as a brand colour; it exists to be removed.
